I’ve attached a short pricing overview and a sample SLO extract for 99th percentile latency and token-cost model at ~100k tokens/day. High-level notes:
- Typical mid-market commitment (reserved pool) yields ~25–35% lower per-token cost vs. hosted burst usage
- Example SLO (99th): 120–180ms for <1k-token responses on Dedicated capacity; hosted numbers vary by model and sequence length
- Estimated token cost at 100k tokens/day (hosted, mixed-precision models): ~$3.2k/day before discounts — ballpark for sizing; we’ll refine based on model choice and batching/caching policies

- redwood-pricing-overview.pdf (pricing tiers + example math)
